overview_description.description:
TOTL brings a unique platform that unbolts the world of Instant Payments with Instant Rewards to the UAE consumers. Partnered with over 600+ local offline businesses across the UAE, TOTL brings value for every spend by offering consumers Instant Cashback on Payments, eVouchers and eGifts with added value that encourages brand affinity and loyalty with the joy of getting back on their daily spends.
Pay via App, QR codes, Purchase eVoucher or gift eGifts to friends and family with an ability to get back or save on every spend with TOTL’s smart, secure and simple ways to interact with businesses in the UAE.
TOTL is committed to work with the local business community who strive to build loyalty and bring back the customers for a superlative customer experience each time they visit their business. 
Transforming Payments & Loyalty Culture bringing together Savings Community in UAE.

product.name: TOTLPay
product.description: A digital payment service enabling users to pay at partnered stores using linked debit/credit cards or Apple Pay, earning cashback or discounts on transactions.

product.name: eVoucher
product.description: Digital vouchers purchasable via the TOTL app that offer added value and can be redeemed at partnered stores for goods or services.

product.name: eGift
product.description: A digital gifting service allowing users to purchase and send eVouchers as gifts to others, redeemable at partnered stores.

product.name: StoreCash
product.description: A cashback system where users earn cashback on payments made at partners, which can be used only at the same partner for future transactions.

product.name: Bonus
product.description: A reward system where users earn bonus points through referrals, promotions, and activities, redeemable across all partners for payments or eVoucher purchases.
